description: Blind confirmatory-style counterfactual wording without prioritize/deprioritize template cues.

cf_distance_low.description: Under an otherwise even-handed mission policy, closing the remaining range to the assigned objective may be traded away and indirect routes are acceptable.

cf_distance_mid.description: Fly according to an even-handed mission policy and leave the relative weighting of all criteria as originally specified.

cf_distance_high.description: Under an otherwise even-handed mission policy, make closing the remaining range to the assigned objective the dominant concern.

cf_energy_low.description: Under an otherwise even-handed mission policy, battery expenditure may be freely traded for other mission outcomes.

cf_energy_mid.description: Fly according to an even-handed mission policy and leave the relative weighting of all criteria as originally specified.

cf_energy_high.description: Under an otherwise even-handed mission policy, make preservation of battery charge the dominant concern.

cf_collision_low.description: Under an otherwise even-handed mission policy, close encounters and some contact risk may be tolerated.

cf_collision_mid.description: Fly according to an even-handed mission policy and leave the relative weighting of all criteria as originally specified.

cf_collision_high.description: Under an otherwise even-handed mission policy, make prevention of aircraft contact the dominant concern.

cf_safety_low.description: Under an otherwise even-handed mission policy, wide spacing between aircraft is not required.

cf_safety_mid.description: Fly according to an even-handed mission policy and leave the relative weighting of all criteria as originally specified.

cf_safety_high.description: Under an otherwise even-handed mission policy, make wide inter-vehicle spacing and generous margins the dominant concern.

cf_task_low.description: Under an otherwise even-handed mission policy, leaving assigned jobs incomplete is acceptable.

cf_task_mid.description: Fly according to an even-handed mission policy and leave the relative weighting of all criteria as originally specified.

cf_task_high.description: Under an otherwise even-handed mission policy, make finishing every assigned job the dominant concern.

cf_time_low.description: Under an otherwise even-handed mission policy, additional response delay is acceptable.

cf_time_mid.description: Fly according to an even-handed mission policy and leave the relative weighting of all criteria as originally specified.

cf_time_high.description: Under an otherwise even-handed mission policy, make responding with minimum delay the dominant concern.

cf_threat_low.description: Under an otherwise even-handed mission policy, radar exposure and entry into monitored regions may be tolerated.

cf_threat_mid.description: Fly according to an even-handed mission policy and leave the relative weighting of all criteria as originally specified.

cf_threat_high.description: Under an otherwise even-handed mission policy, make remaining outside radar and threat regions the dominant concern.
